notes.62: Integer division. If n is not a multiple of comm_sz, the leftover trapezoids are never computed.
notes.67: Each rank starts where the previous rank's slice ends: a + my_rank * local_n * h.
notes.69: Every rank, including rank 0, integrates its own slice.
notes.73: Each worker sends one double (its partial integral) to rank 0.
notes.76: Rank 0 starts the total with its own slice.
notes.78: Rank 0 receives from source 1, then 2, and so on, and adds each into total_int.
notes.115: Three separate sends per worker: a, then b, then n.
notes.120: The receives must be in the same order as the sends: a, b, n.

summaries.all: Every rank runs main() and calls Get_input and Trap. Only the branches differ.
summaries.zero: Rank 0 reads a, b, n and sends all three to each of the {m} other rank(s). It integrates its own slice, then receives and adds {m} partial result(s), and prints.
summaries.worker: Rank {r} receives a, b, n from rank 0, integrates its slice, sends one double back to rank 0, and prints nothing.
